title: A Novel Sensor Deployment Strategy Based on Probabilistic Perception for Industrial Wireless Sensor Network
content: With the development of Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) technology, wireless sensor networks have become increasingly important. Sensor deployment in the Industrial Internet is a key element for achieving intelligent production and equipment monitoring.  The use of the sensors efficiently and collaboratively has become a popular research topic in the IIoT field. In this paper, we focus on the sensor deployment strategy to guarantee communication quality and transmission speed. This paper introduces an innovative approach by normalizing four critical metrics: deployment cost, energy consumption, network connectivity, and sensing probability. In this way, the proposed method eliminates the differences in dimensional units between these metrics and assigns unique weights based on their relative importance. Additionally, the paper incorporates larger-scale obstacles into the model to better accommodate varying environmental and scene-specific requirements. A series of diverse simulation experiments were designed and conducted across different scenarios. The simulation results demonstrate that, when compared to other similar algorithms, the particle swarm-genetic hybrid algorithm shows superior performance in optimizing the newly proposed metric of network performance. Furthermore, the algorithm also exhibits a noticeable improvement in terms of search convergence time, contributing to its overall effectiveness and efficiency in network optimization tasks.
